name: Extract diffusion metrics inside ROIs
summary: Extracts summary statistics (min, max, mean, median, mode, SD, non-zero count) of tensor, NODDI and myelin maps inside each ROI with Connectome Workbench, as CSVs.
description: Optionally inflates the ROIs (MATLAB smooth3), resamples ROIs and metric maps to the DWI grid with FreeSurfer mri_vol2vol, computes per-ROI statistics with wb_command -volume-stats, and writes one CSV per statistic. Values of metrics whose median is below 0.01 (for example diffusivities in mm2/s) are multiplied by 1000.

inputs.description: The path to the DWI datatype
The path to the tensor datatype files
The path to the NODDI datatype files
Optional myelin map, resampled to the DWI grid like the diffusion maps.
The path to the top directory containing the ROIs within which diffusion metrics will be extracted
inputs.requirements: ROIs must be in the same space as the DWI (resampled with --regheader).

outputs.description: Directory of CSVs (MIN, MAX, MEAN, MEDIAN, MODE, STDEV, COUNT_NONZERO) with one row per ROI and one column per metric.

parameters.description: Inflate (smooth and re-binarise) the ROIs before extracting metrics.
Box-kernel size for ROI inflation (odd number); used only when inflate is true.

failure_modes.fix: Check that ROIs and metric maps are in DWI space and inspect the logs.
